goal: Extend RubricGrader with optional judge_model and retry_on_fail fields and pass them through flywheel.loaders.parse_grader without weakening the strict-parsing contract.

references: src/flywheel/task.py:22-32 -- existing RubricGrader dataclass that gains two new kw_only fields with defaults
src/flywheel/loaders.py:98-103 -- rubric branch of _build_grader that must thread the new fields through
src/flywheel/task.py:48-65 -- TranscriptGrader: mirror its kw_only optional-field pattern when adding judge_model and retry_on_fail
src/flywheel/task.py:6-7 -- ValidationError used to reject malformed inputs
constraints: Add `judge_model: str | None = None` and `retry_on_fail: bool = True` to RubricGrader as kw_only fields. The existing __post_init__ continues to validate assertions; add a type check that retry_on_fail is a bool (the loader passes whatever the JSON supplies, so this defends against truthy non-bools like 'true' strings).
flywheel.task MUST stay pure. No new imports beyond what is already there. tests/test_task_module_purity.py must continue to pass unchanged.

In loaders._build_grader, the rubric branch (line 98) reads `judge_model` and `retry_on_fail` from the entry dict and forwards them. Use `entry.get('judge_model')` (None when omitted) and `entry.get('retry_on_fail', True)` to preserve the default. Wrap construction in the existing ValidationError -> TaskLoadError adapter at line 116-117.

The loader must reject `retry_on_fail` when present but not a bool (string 'true' / 'false', int 0/1, null) -- per the spec edge case 'Loader receives retry_on_fail as a string'. Reuse the strict-typing pattern already used for assertions.

tests/test_task.py: add cases covering (a) RubricGrader defaults (judge_model is None, retry_on_fail is True); (b) round-trip with judge_model='claude-haiku-4-5' and retry_on_fail=False; (c) ValidationError when retry_on_fail is constructed with a non-bool.

tests/test_loaders.py: add cases covering (a) parsing a rubric grader with judge_model and retry_on_fail set; (b) parsing without either field uses defaults; (c) TaskLoadError when retry_on_fail is the string 'false'; (d) TaskLoadError when judge_model is provided as a non-string. Existing rubric-loader tests must keep passing as-is.

Update docs/task-schema.md `rubric` table (around the existing `assertions / rubric / name` rows) to document `judge_model` (optional string, overrides HarnessConfig.rubric_judge_model when set) and `retry_on_fail` (optional bool, default true; when false the rubric-failed attempt routes to INTERRUPTED instead of FAILED_VALIDATION). Keep prose terse.
Run `mcp__ide__getDiagnostics` on every .py file you touch and fix all Pylance errors before reporting verify.
Commit the change with a Conventional Commits message (e.g. 'feat:') before reporting verify.
non_goals: Do not touch src/flywheel/harness.py, src/flywheel/prompt.py, or any grader runner -- those layers come in later tasks in this phase.
Do not create grader_rubric.py in this task.
Do not change CommandGrader, ManualGrader, or TranscriptGrader.
Do not edit docs/vision.md or docs/loop.md in this task.
Do not change the `rubric` payload shape documented at src/flywheel/_schema/persistence-schema.sql:73.
edge_cases: retry_on_fail defaults to True (matches the spec's MVP behavior change from pause-for-review to auto-retry).
judge_model=None is a valid persisted value; do not coerce it to an empty string.
A rubric entry that supplies an unrelated unknown key (e.g. 'judge_provider') is silently ignored today; do not tighten that behavior in this task.
Existing call sites that build RubricGrader positionally are kw_only-only today; the new fields are also kw_only, so no positional ordering concerns.

graders.run: uv run pytest tests/test_task.py tests/test_task_module_purity.py tests/test_loaders.py -v
